seo.title: Custom Flags - WOLFLAG
seo.description: Custom flag service: design, digital/silkscreen printing, and production at our factory in China. From artwork to delivery.

sections.title: 1. Send us your artwork
sections.text: Share your logo, colors or sketch. We accept CorelDRAW, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop files, or high-resolution PDF. Our designers check the artwork and send you a free digital proof before production.

sections.title: 2. We produce at our factory
sections.text: More than 23 years of experience in flag production. Digital printing or silkscreen printing on quality fabric with a wide range of materials, sizes and finishing options.

sections.title: 3. Worldwide delivery
sections.text: From our factory directly to your door — we arrange sea or air shipping and handle customs clearance for you. Get factory-direct prices without middlemen.
